candidate_program.name: peak_gated_pressure_blend
candidate_program.rationale: Uses count efficiency when the root matches or exceeds its strongest rival; otherwise blends in weighted competition. This root-local conditional adds no feature scans, but strongest-rival dominance does not establish an inclusion certificate.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) if weight >= max_conflict_weight else 0.9 * weight / (1 + degree) + 0.1 * weight * (1 + weight) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
